words.ex: The title was abbreviated to fit the slide.
words.exZh: 標題被縮短以配合投影片。

words.ex: Notes accompany each slide.
words.exZh: 每張投影片都附有註記。

words.ex: Accuracy matters more than speed here.
words.exZh: 在此準確性比速度重要。

words.ex: Make sure the figures are accurate before publishing.
words.exZh: 發布前請確保數字準確。

words.ex: She adapted the deck for a technical audience.
words.exZh: 她為技術背景的聽眾調整了簡報。

words.ex: Allow adequate time for questions.
words.exZh: 請留足夠時間提問。

words.ex: Check the alignment of the chart labels.
words.exZh: 請檢查圖表標籤的對齊。

words.ex: The analysis covers three fiscal years.
words.exZh: 該分析涵蓋三個會計年度。

words.ex: He annotated the diagram with key figures.
words.exZh: 他在圖表上加註了關鍵數字。

words.ex: Detailed tables are in the appendix.
words.exZh: 詳細表格放在附錄。

words.ex: We took a data-driven approach.
words.exZh: 我們採取以數據為本的方法。

words.ex: That assertion needs supporting evidence.
words.exZh: 那項主張需要佐證。

words.ex: The opening story captured everyone's attention.
words.exZh: 開場故事抓住了所有人的注意力。

words.ex: Please speak loudly enough to be audible.
words.exZh: 請說得夠大聲讓大家聽得見。

words.ex: We benchmarked our results against the industry.
words.exZh: 我們把成果與業界基準對照。

words.ex: Brevity is valued in executive briefings.
words.exZh: 高層簡報重視簡潔。

words.ex: Limit each slide to five bullet points.
words.exZh: 每張投影片限五個項目。

words.ex: Every figure should have a caption.
words.exZh: 每張圖都應該有圖說。

words.ex: Expenses are grouped into four categories.
words.exZh: 支出分為四個類別。

words.ex: The chart shows a steady upward trend.
words.exZh: 圖表顯示穩定的上升趨勢。

words.ex: Include a citation for every statistic.
words.exZh: 每項統計都要附上出處。

words.ex: The revision improved the clarity of the message.
words.exZh: 修訂提升了訊息的清晰度。

words.ex: The report lacks coherence between sections.
words.exZh: 報告各章節之間缺乏連貫性。

words.ex: The third column shows the variance.
words.exZh: 第三欄顯示差異數。

words.ex: The slide compares last year with this year.
words.exZh: 該投影片比較去年與今年。

words.ex: A side-by-side comparison would help.
words.exZh: 並排比較會很有幫助。

words.ex: She made a compelling case for investment.
words.exZh: 她提出了具說服力的投資理由。

words.ex: Each component of the plan was explained.
words.exZh: 計畫的每個組成部分都獲得說明。

words.ex: Keep the technical parts comprehensible.
words.exZh: 請讓技術部分維持可理解。

words.ex: She spoke with quiet confidence.
words.exZh: 她說話時帶著沉穩的自信。

words.ex: Use consistent units throughout.
words.exZh: 全篇請使用一致的單位。

words.ex: Provide context before showing numbers.
words.exZh: 呈現數字前先提供脈絡。

words.ex: The demo convinced the skeptics.
words.exZh: 展示說服了懷疑者。

words.ex: There is a strong correlation between the two.
words.exZh: 兩者之間有強烈相關性。

words.ex: Citing sources builds credibility.
words.exZh: 引用出處能建立可信度。

words.ex: The source is credible and well documented.
words.exZh: 該來源可信且有完整佐證。

words.ex: The data supports our recommendation.
words.exZh: 數據支持我們的建議。

words.ex: The chart shows a sharp decline in Q3.
words.exZh: 圖表顯示第三季大幅下滑。

words.ex: He demonstrated the prototype on stage.
words.exZh: 他在台上示範了原型。

words.ex: The graph depicts quarterly revenue.
words.exZh: 該圖描繪季度營收。

words.ex: The appendix details the methodology.
words.exZh: 附錄詳述了方法論。

words.ex: A small deviation from the forecast is normal.
words.exZh: 與預測有小幅偏差是正常的。

words.ex: The diagram explains the approval flow.
words.exZh: 該圖解說明核准流程。

words.ex: We must disclose all material assumptions.
words.exZh: 我們必須揭露所有重大假設。

words.ex: Our estimate assumes stable demand.
words.exZh: 我們的估計假設需求穩定。

words.ex: The panel will evaluate each submission.
words.exZh: 評審小組將評估每份提交。

words.ex: There is strong evidence of improvement.
words.exZh: 有強力證據顯示情況改善。

words.ex: Avoid exaggerating the projected savings.
words.exZh: 避免誇大預期節省。

words.ex: Results exceeded the original target.
words.exZh: 成果超過了原定目標。

words.ex: An excerpt from the report was quoted.
words.exZh: 報告中的一段摘錄被引用。

words.ex: Exhibit B lists the raw figures.
words.exZh: 附件 B 列出原始數字。

words.ex: Refer to figure three on page ten.
words.exZh: 請參見第十頁的圖三。

words.ex: The main finding surprised the committee.
words.exZh: 主要發現令委員會意外。

words.ex: Demand fluctuates with the season.
words.exZh: 需求隨季節波動。

words.ex: Use a larger font for the back rows.
words.exZh: 請用較大字型讓後排看清楚。

words.ex: The forecast assumes no price change.
words.exZh: 預測假設價格不變。

words.ex: Please format the tables consistently.
words.exZh: 請讓表格格式一致。

words.ex: We start with two fundamental questions.
words.exZh: 我們從兩個基本問題開始。

words.ex: Natural gestures make a talk more engaging.
words.exZh: 自然的手勢讓演講更吸引人。

words.ex: The graph plots cost against volume.
words.exZh: 該圖表繪出成本與數量的關係。

words.ex: The horizontal axis shows time.
words.exZh: 水平軸表示時間。

words.ex: This example illustrates the problem well.
words.exZh: 這個例子清楚說明了問題。

words.ex: Consider the implications for staffing.
words.exZh: 請考慮對人力配置的影響。

words.ex: The data implies a shift in preference.
words.exZh: 數據暗示偏好正在轉變。

words.ex: The two tables are inconsistent.
words.exZh: 這兩張表格不一致。

words.ex: The results indicate a downward trend.
words.exZh: 結果顯示下降趨勢。

words.ex: That inference is not supported by the data.
words.exZh: 該推論並未獲得數據支持。

words.ex: The figures can be interpreted two ways.
words.exZh: 這些數字可以有兩種解讀。

words.ex: Keep the introduction under two minutes.
words.exZh: 引言請控制在兩分鐘內。

words.ex: Provide justification for each line item.
words.exZh: 請為每個項目提供理由。

words.ex: Label both axes clearly.
words.exZh: 請清楚標示兩個座標軸。

words.ex: The legend explains each color.
words.exZh: 圖例說明了每種顏色。

words.ex: Leave a wider margin for notes.
words.exZh: 請留較寬的邊界供做筆記。

words.ex: The methodology section is quite technical.
words.exZh: 方法論這一節相當技術性。

words.ex: The change had a minimal impact.
words.exZh: 該變更影響極小。

words.ex: Every deck needs a clear narrative.
words.exZh: 每份簡報都需要清楚的敘事主軸。

words.ex: There was a noticeable improvement.
words.exZh: 有明顯的改善。

words.ex: Do not overstate the confidence level.
words.exZh: 請勿誇大信心水準。

words.ex: She kept a steady pace throughout.
words.exZh: 她全程維持穩定的節奏。

words.ex: A small percentage of users reported issues.
words.exZh: 少數比例的使用者回報了問題。

words.ex: The closing argument was persuasive.
words.exZh: 結論的論證很有說服力。

words.ex: Use a pointer to highlight the trend line.
words.exZh: 請用指標點出趨勢線。

words.ex: These are preliminary results only.
words.exZh: 這些僅是初步結果。

words.ex: The presentation lasted forty minutes.
words.exZh: 簡報進行了四十分鐘。

words.ex: The projector needs a new bulb.
words.exZh: 投影機需要換燈泡。

words.ex: A large proportion of costs is fixed.
words.exZh: 很大比例的成本是固定的。

words.ex: The pilot proved the concept viable.
words.exZh: 試辦證明了這個概念可行。

words.ex: Please send any queries by email.
words.exZh: 如有疑問請以郵件寄送。

words.ex: He quoted the CEO's remarks accurately.
words.exZh: 他準確引述了執行長的話。

words.ex: We recommend a phased rollout.
words.exZh: 我們建議分階段推行。

words.ex: We rehearsed the demo three times.
words.exZh: 我們把展示排練了三次。

words.ex: The sample size makes the result reliable.
words.exZh: 樣本數讓結果可靠。

words.ex: Each bar represents one region.
words.exZh: 每根長條代表一個地區。

words.ex: Sales rose 5% and 8% respectively.
words.exZh: 銷售分別成長 5% 與 8%。

words.ex: The breakdown reveals where costs rose.
words.exZh: 明細揭示了成本上升的位置。

words.ex: Define the scope before the deep dive.
words.exZh: 深入之前先界定範圍。

words.ex: The premium segment grew fastest.
words.exZh: 高階區隔成長最快。

words.ex: The difference is statistically significant.
words.exZh: 該差異在統計上顯著。

words.ex: Simplify the chart to one message.
words.exZh: 把圖表簡化到只傳達一個訊息。

words.ex: Go back one slide, please.
words.exZh: 請往回一張投影片。

words.ex: That statistic comes from a 2023 survey.
words.exZh: 該統計數字來自 2023 年的調查。

words.ex: There was a substantial increase in traffic.
words.exZh: 流量有大幅增加。

words.ex: We have sufficient data to conclude.
words.exZh: 我們有足夠資料下結論。

words.ex: The executive summary is one page long.
words.exZh: 執行摘要長度為一頁。

words.ex: Charts supplement the written analysis.
words.exZh: 圖表補充了書面分析。

words.ex: We surveyed 400 customers last month.
words.exZh: 我們上個月調查了 400 位客戶。

words.ex: The key takeaway is simple.
words.exZh: 關鍵結論很簡單。

words.ex: Define any unfamiliar terminology.
words.exZh: 請定義任何不熟悉的術語。

words.ex: The transition between sections felt abrupt.
words.exZh: 各節之間的轉場顯得突兀。

words.ex: The upward trend continued into June.
words.exZh: 上升趨勢延續到六月。

words.ex: We validated the model against real data.
words.exZh: 我們用實際資料驗證了模型。

words.ex: The variance was within acceptable limits.
words.exZh: 差異在可接受範圍內。

words.ex: The vertical axis shows units sold.
words.exZh: 垂直軸顯示售出單位數。

words.ex: Strong visuals help the audience follow.
words.exZh: 好的視覺素材幫助聽眾跟上。
